title: Ready Configuration as Startup Call
statement: Let $B$ and $F$ be finite Boolean Turing machines, let $a$ be a state of $B$, and let $x$ be a Boolean input word. For every configuration $c$ of $F$ on $x$, the ready configuration determined by $c$ equals the call configuration for the initial configuration of $B$ on $x$, with startup set to true, release set to false, no flag, and the fuel word and fuel configuration inherited from $c$.
